sections.content:
Confirmed: clicking the dot at (51,12) moved the purple square from (52-54, 9-11) to (50-52, 11-13) — i.e., the center of the dot. The dot at (51,12) got consumed (now the center of the square is G? Actually (51,12) is now 'p', and (53,10) is 'G' — interestingly, the old position left a gray dot at (53,10)? Wait, (53,10) was previously 'p' and is now 'G'. Hmm, so the square moved from center (53,10) to center (51,12), and the old center became a G dot (the line's dot was restored), while the new center is… (51,12) was G and is now p.
So the mechanic: the purple square moves along the dotted line one step at a time. Clicking the next dot moves the square there. The old position becomes a dot again. The square's center is currently (51,12).
Wait, but the square is 3x3 and the dots are 1x1. When the square is at (50-52, 11-13), the dots behind it (53,10), (55,8), (57,6) reappear.
So the goal: move the square along the line all the way to the blue flower in the upper right. Dots: (49,14), (47,16), (45,18), (43,20), (41,22), (39,24), (37,26), (35,28), (33,30), (31,32), (29,34), (27,36), (25,38), (23,40), (21,42), and then the flower at (11-19, 44-52) — the flower's center is around (15,48).
After (21,42), the next step along the line would be (19,44), (17,46), (15,48)… but the flower occupies that area. Maybe the final click is on the flower itself.
Plan: batch-click the remaining dots in order: (49,14), (47,16), (45,18), (43,20), (41,22), (39,24), (37,26), (35,28), (33,30), (31,32), (29,34), (27,36), (25,38), (23,40), (21,42), and then the flower's center (15,48).
But wait — can I batch multiple actions in one call? Yes, action(actions) accepts a list. But if the mechanic requires each click to be at the "next" dot, then batching in the correct order should work. Risk: if a click fails (e.g., the square doesn't move), subsequent clicks will be off. Let me batch the first few, verify, then continue.
Actually, let me be careful: each action costs 2 pixels of the timer bar. The bar started at 64 and is now 62… after 2 actions: 64→62→60? The first diff showed (63,62), (63,63) W→B, so 64→62. The second showed (63,60), (63,61) W→B, so 62→60. So 2 pixels per action. 60 remaining → 30 actions available. About 16 clicks needed. OK.
Let me batch the next 4 dots and verify.
